prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the passenger in a hit while turning left in Houston, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1140; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for giving us a few minutes today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were involved in while riding as a passenger in Houston, Texas. Is it all right if I record this conversation?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please tell me where you were sitting in the vehicle at the time of the collision.

A: I was in the front passenger seat. The driver was taking a left turn at an intersection when another car came through from the opposite direction.

Q: Do you recall whether the vehicle you were in was completing the turn or had already begun it?

A: We were in the middle of the turn. We had been waiting for a gap in traffic, and then the other car hit us on the driver's side area, toward the front.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before impact?

A: Not really. I looked up just as we were moving, and there was a bright set of headlights, then the impact.

Q: Did you hit your head or any part of your body on anything inside the vehicle?

A: My head snapped forward and then back. I didn't strike anything directly, but my neck jerked hard.

Q: When did you first notice pain or stiffness?

A: I felt a dull ache in my neck within an hour or so. By the next morning, the stiffness had spread into my shoulders and upper back, and turning my head to check mirrors hurt.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to a clinic the following day and I've been seeing a physical therapist twice a week since then.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add before we finish?

A: No, I think I've covered it. I just want to get my neck back to normal.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
